info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Product Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The Product Deployment Management API provides access to detailed information regarding specific product deployments in the banking sector. By querying with a unique identifier, users can retrieve comprehensive data about the status, configurations, and metrics associated with product deployments. This API is essential for developers and business analysts who need to monitor and manage product deployment processes effectively. Use cases include analytical reporting, product lifecycle management, and operational oversight.

get.summary: Retrieve details of a specific product deployment.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information about a specific product deployment identified by its unique ID. It provides necessary insights and status updates concerning the deployment, helping stakeholders make informed decisions.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve product deployment details for a specific product identified by PROD-700045. It requires a properly formatted JSON payload that adheres to the defined schema.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the product deployment details.
